test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All computers are footballs.

Some footballs are round.

Some round are stools.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some footballs are computers.

II. Some round are footballs.

III. Some stools are round.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

solution:
Given Statements:

All computers are footballs.

Some footballs are round.

Some round are stools.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44dae366ee3e6e2728885f047044c00c5236de34a784628057eed9850a8bd37d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some footballs are computers - True (Because, All computers are footballs, so some footballs are computers).

II. Some round are footballs - True (Because, Some footballs are round).

III. Some stools are round - True (Because, Some round are stools).

So, All the conclusions follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
